# Scavenger's Compact

**Type:** Mutual aid society for independent Hollows scavengers
**Territory:** The Hollows (informal), with meeting places in Thornwall and Nexus
**Size:** ~100 dues-paying members, plus affiliates

## Overview

The Scavenger's Compact is what keeps independent scavengers alive. Not everyone can join a Hollows Crew — some people work alone, or in pairs, or with partners who change from week to week. The Compact gives them the one thing crews take for granted: a network.

The Compact maintains a shared map of the Hollows — updated constantly as members report phasing shifts, new hazards, cleared routes, and dead ends. It provides a mutual aid fund for scavengers injured on the job. And it enforces the unwritten rules: you don't jump another scavenger's claim, you don't leave a wounded scavenger behind, and you don't sell information about the Hollows to outsiders without Compact approval.

Membership is informal — you pay your dues (a percentage of your hauls), you follow the rules, and you're in. Break the rules, and no Compact member will work with you, buy from you, or warn you about an approaching phasing event. In the Hollows, that's a death sentence.

## The Map

The Compact's map is its most valuable asset — a living document maintained in a secure location in the Warrens, updated weekly by a cartographer known only as the Cartographer. The map shows current routes through the Hollows, phasing patterns, known hazards, and the locations of major finds.

The Cartographer is said to be a former Athenaeum scholar who was expelled for reasons they won't discuss. They've been maintaining the map for fifteen years. No one knows their real name. No one asks.

## Leadership

The Compact has no formal leadership. A rotating council of senior members — the **Old Hands** — arbitrates disputes and makes policy decisions. The current Old Hands are a Riftborn woman who's been scavenging the Hollows for thirty years, a retired Hollows Crew captain who lost their crew to a phasing event and swore off crew life, and a Thornwall fence who handles the Compact's finances.

## Hooks

- The map has been wrong for three consecutive weeks — routes that should be safe are phasing unpredictably, landmarks are moving, and one sector that was mapped as "stable" has swallowed two scavengers. The Cartographer is working around the clock. They're not sure the map CAN be accurate anymore.
- A scavenger found something in the Hollows — a complete Warden artifact, intact, humming. They brought it to the Compact instead of selling it. The Old Hands are debating what to do with it. Every major faction will want it. The Compact just wants to stay out of the crossfire.
